definitions.explanation: Written or presented in a way that ordinary people can easily understand, as opposed to specialized or academic content.
Lacking refinement or depth; appealing to mass taste rather than intellectual or artistic merit.

notes:
Can be either neutral or negative depending on context. In sense 1, it describes making specialized content accessible to a general audience, which can be positive. In sense 2, it implies a lack of depth or sophistication and carries a dismissive tone. The word ⟦{通俗|つうぞく}→通俗：22441_tsuuzoku⟧ literally means "passing through the common people," suggesting content aimed at the masses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通俗的|つうぞくてき}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: plain/accessible expression
- {通俗的|つうぞくてき}な⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧: popular interpretation
- {通俗的|つうぞくてき}な⟦{読|よ}み{物|もの}→読み物：14216_yomimono⟧: popular reading material
- ⟦{通俗|つうぞく}→通俗：22441_tsuuzoku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: popular fiction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大衆的|たいしゅうてき}: popular; mass-market — focuses on broad appeal without the negative connotation of lacking depth
- ⟦{庶民的|しょみんてき}→庶民的：15780_shominteki⟧: common; down-to-earth — implies warmth and relatability rather than intellectual judgment
- ⟦{俗|ぞく}→俗：24364_zoku⟧⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: vulgar; common — more colloquial and more negative than {通俗的|つうぞくてき}
